lines.en: I keep to the cave wall.
My shell scrapes the stone.
Low body, shifting forward.

lines.zh: 每一步都在碎石上试探。
lines.en: Every step tests the rubble.
I go around the puddles.
I see fine in the dark.
Many legs, steady going.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴下的水打在背上。
lines.en: Drips from the roof hit my shell.
I follow the tunnel deeper.
My feelers go out first.

lines.zh: 脚下有骨头，我踩过去了。
lines.en: Bones underfoot. I step over.
I close in on the entrance.
I crushed a patch of dry moss.
Echoes follow me along the wall.
I pause at the fork.
Flat on the stone, I don't move.

lines.zh: 甲壳的颜色和岩壁一样。
lines.en: My shell matches the rock.

lines.zh: 我在听洞穴深处的声音。
lines.en: Listening to something deeper in.
Water drips from above.
I don't need light at all.

lines.zh: 我的关节紧紧扣着石头。
lines.en: My joints lock onto the stone.
Something small crawled by.
Waiting for someone to walk in.
I know every part of this cave.
My marks are on the walls.
My mouthparts move slowly.

lines.zh: 空气里有一点活物的味。
lines.en: There's a living smell in the air.
I hold the narrowest passage.

lines.zh: 我的甲在阴影里不反光。
lines.en: My shell gives no shine in the dark.

lines.zh: 你的火把只能照一小块。
lines.en: Your torch lights only a patch.
This is the entrance, not a way through.
I've held this place a long while.
You can still go back.
Your skin is far too soft.
Down here, I'm the master.
One step further and you're mine.

lines.zh: 洞里的活物，我全看得见。
lines.en: Nothing alive in this cave escapes my sight.
A crack has opened in my shell.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了道缝，我往石缝里缩。
lines.en: A crack in my shell; I shrink into the rock seam.
One of my legs got crushed.
Fluid leaks from the seams.
The cave's echoes have changed.
I still hold this entrance.
Even bones made of stone can ache.
Back off — I can still fight.
I keep watch at the cave mouth.
Only living things taste right.
That thing in your hand is too dry.

lines.zh: 我闻不出有什么好吃的。
lines.en: I can't smell anything worth eating.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中这一点也不诱人。
lines.en: That's not tempting in the dark.
I want something that moves.
I'm not picky, but I prefer it alive.
That thing... put it down, then leave.
You kicked my shell.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的六条腿钉在原地。
lines.en: You slam into me; my six legs stay planted.
Back up. This passage is narrow.
You stepped on one of my legs.
Don't squeeze along the wall.
I slid past your feet.
Crowd me again and I bite.
Stone is falling from the roof.
Neither of us is going anywhere fast.

lines.zh: 洞穴里的幼卵不需要这些。
lines.en: The brood in this cave needs none of that.
I'm only here to guard.
That question isn't mine.
There are no seasons down here.
I only know the smell of stone.
I won't give an answer to that.
There's only me and the rock.

lines.zh: 别站在我的洞口问这个。
lines.en: Don't ask that at my entrance.
This bone is very old.
I push it toward the nest.

lines.zh: 这枚发亮的石片，我拨到一旁。
lines.en: This glinting stone chip; I shove it aside.
Something's moving under the stone.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，我用前肢翻了个面。
lines.en: I flip this bone over with my front limbs.
It's too bright. It stings.
Too heavy for me.
I bury it in the rubble.
That smell is unfamiliar.
Footsteps entered the tunnel.
I've fixed on that sound.
Torchlight is swinging.
It's coming my way.
I've pressed flat to the wall.
There's only one way through here.
First I cut off its retreat.
My forelimbs are raised.
It's hesitating. Good.

lines.zh: 再走三步就进我的范围。
lines.en: Three steps more and it's in reach.

lines.zh: 我看得见它火把的反光。
lines.en: I can see the glow of its torch.
It's stopped at the big stone.
I've made no sound at all.
Its light swept over.
It's started down again.
The floor here is slick.
I creep along the ground.
Its breathing echoes loudly.
The moment it turns is best.
I'm at its rear flank.

lines.zh: 石头挡住了它一半视线。
lines.en: A rock blocks half its view.
It hasn't heard me at all.
Forelimbs come down on your knee.

lines.zh: 颚钳住你的脚踝，甲壳一顶。
lines.en: My mandibles clamp your ankle and my shell heaves.
This one comes with rubble.
I ram you with my shell.

lines.zh: 你退了半步，正是我要的。
lines.en: Half a step back — exactly what I wanted.
I came up from behind you.
Kick me. The shell doesn't care.
I've got hold of the boot.
You shoved me back a step.
I slip back into the shadow.
One step closer and I bite again.
I crawl out of the rock seam.
This cave is mine.
Wet moss clings to my shell.
I lie in the shadow of the entrance.
There's light up there. I dislike it.
I test the stone with my forelimbs.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶的石缝里倒挂下来。
lines.en: I lower myself from a crack in the cave roof.
These tunnels run deep.
I smell something coming down.
These stone caves are bitterly cold.
I extend my feelers.
I walked over old bones.

lines.zh: 石壁让我的脚步声很轻。
lines.en: The walls muffle my steps.
I stop at the narrowest point.
The firelight drives me back.
I dropped into a deeper tunnel.
Water suddenly filled the tunnel.

lines.zh: 爆炸震落了洞顶的石头。
lines.en: The blast brought the roof down.

lines.zh: 一根尖刺卡进我的甲缝。
lines.en: A sharp point wedged in my shell seam.
That light made the walls blinding.
Nothing living is left in this cave.

lines.zh: 雷光沿着石壁钻进洞里。
lines.en: Lightning ran along the wall into the cave.
There's a deeper dark below.
